entities.name: PMID:25098661
observations: 2014 crossover study compared two hinged ankle braces allowing free sagittal-plane plantar-flexion/dorsiflexion with one nonhinged brace in 17 healthy volunteers.

All braces reduced dynamic and passive foot inversion versus control; hinged models allowed greater passive plantar flexion, and differences in inversion stabilization were not judged clinically relevant.

entities.name: Three-brace sagittal rotation comparison
observations: The study tested three ankle braces: two hinged braces with free sagittal-plane motion and one nonhinged brace; braces reduced inversion, while hinged braces allowed greater passive plantar flexion.
